description:
## Context
Issue #835: `plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/on-event.mjs:45` parses `ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS` with a bare `Number(process.env.ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS ?? 30_000)`. Non-numeric strings (`"30s"`, `"abc"`) yield `NaN` and empty/whitespace strings (`""`) yield `0`, both of which cause `bucketFor` to return `null` and silently disable nudge deduplication on every agent status flap.

## Normative Decisions
1. In `plugins/adlc-herdr/lib/nudge.mjs`, export `DEFAULT_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS = 30_000` and `resolveNudgeWindowMs(raw, warn = console.error)`.
2. When `raw === undefined`, `resolveNudgeWindowMs` returns `DEFAULT_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS` with no warning. When `raw` trims to an empty string or `Number(trimmed)` is not finite (`!Number.isFinite(parsed)`), call `warn` with a diagnostic naming `ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS` and the fallback `30000` ms, and return `DEFAULT_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS`. When `parsed` is a finite number (including `<= 0` for explicit opt-out), return `parsed`.
3. Wire `resolveNudgeWindowMs(process.env.ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS)` in `plugins/adlc-herdr/bin/on-event.mjs` and document `ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS` in `plugins/adlc-herdr/README.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AC1: `resolveNudgeWindowMs` returns `30_000` and logs a warning for non-numeric or empty values (`"30s"`, `""`, `"   "`, `"NaN"`, `"Infinity"`), while honoring explicit `<= 0` disable values (`"0"`, `"-5"`) and positive numbers without warning (`verify: node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/nudge.test.mjs`).
- AC2: `bin/on-event.mjs` deduplicates rapid flaps when `ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS` is malformed (`"30s"`) and emits a warning on stderr (`verify: node --test plugins/adlc-herdr/test/on-event-e2e.test.mjs`).
title: plugin(adlc-herdr): validate ADLC_HERDR_NUDGE_WINDOW_MS and fall back to 30s on malformed values (#835)
